newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo jumps after U.S. presentation.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo jumps after U.S. presentation.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc jumped to a fresh peak on Monday, after a favourable reception to the pharmaceutical's group presentation to analysts and investors in New York on Friday, dealers said.
By 1404 GMT, the shares were up 22p to 1110-1/2, having risen as high as 1112 earlier. Trading volume topped three million shares.
Favourable press comments over the weekend added to investors' optimism, dealers said.

Just last week, the UK drug giant posted an 18 percent increase in 1996 pre-tax profits. Glaxo said its profits could be flat during the next two years after its blockbuster Zantac loses its U.S. patent in July, before returning to double-digit growth in 1999. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
